why: B (definitions-only item; IsCritMap is defined but B only asserts the properties of γ_v): on every abstract connected Hausdorff ℝⁿ-manifold with any smooth Mathlib RiemannianBundle metric and any Levi-Civita connection, Milnor-complete, γ_v(t) = exp_p(tv) is a geodesic on [0,1] with γ_v(0) = p, γ_v(1) = exp_p(v) and initial velocity v. A (universes 0; expDomAt, dExpAt vocabulary): for slice submanifolds N ⊆ V with the induced metric only, no completeness: the domain of exp_q is open, exp_q is C^∞ on it, γ_v is a geodesic on an open interval containing [0,1] and a smooth curve in N on [0,1] for v in the domain, and the domain is T_qN for complete N. A ⇒ B fails genuinely (setting: abstract manifolds are not given embedded, no abstract exp in the project); B ⇒ A fails genuinely (setting; B says nothing about openness/smoothness of exp or incomplete N). On embedded manifolds B_emb follows from A, and in fact holds outright from Chapter 7 (B_emb_holds), so A's content is not needed for it; B_emb gives back A's ray statements for complete N.
